import re
def money(x):
    s=str(x).strip().lower().replace('đ','').replace(' ','')
    if s in('nan','','none'): return 0.0
    neg=s.startswith('-'); s=s.lstrip('-')
    m=re.fullmatch(r'(\d+)tr(\d*)',s)
    if m: v=int(m.group(1))*1e6+(int(m.group(2).ljust(3,'0')[:3])*1e3 if m.group(2) else 0)
    elif re.fullmatch(r'\d+[,.]\d+tr',s): v=float(s[:-2].replace(',','.'))*1e6
    elif s.endswith('k'): v=float(s[:-1].replace(',','.'))*1e3
    elif re.fullmatch(r'\d{1,3}(\.\d{3})+',s): v=float(s.replace('.',''))
    elif re.fullmatch(r'\d{1,3}(,\d{3})+(\.\d*)?',s): v=float(s.replace(',',''))
    else: v=float(s.replace(',','.'))
    return -v if neg else v
